//: Merge these into the 'hooks' section of ~/.claude/settings.json. They pull the memory base when a Claude Code session starts and push your new knowledge when it ends. Windows version shown; for macOS/Linux use: git -C ~/claude-memory pull --rebase --autostash --quiet (start) and MEMORY_DIR=~/claude-memory bash /path/to/memory-sync.sh (end). The push goes through memory-push.ps1 / memory-sync.sh so the secret gate can catch key-shaped content before it reaches the remote — copy that script into your memory base first.
